item.lordsoutpost.lord_standard.desc: Place it in the yard of a conquered outpost to become its Lord.
lordsoutpost.law.none.desc: Business as usual: no bonuses, no penalties.
lordsoutpost.law.martial_law.desc: Defense +30%, guards hit harder, half again as many recruits. Resource output −25%.
lordsoutpost.law.trade_and_magic.desc: Tribute and caravan profit +50%, the Mage works twice as fast. Defense −10%.
lordsoutpost.law.shock_construction.desc: Construction twice as fast. Food use up by a quarter, output −15%.
lordsoutpost.access.ally.desc: Guards are friendly, gates and citadel open, chests and workstations usable. Cannot break buildings.
lordsoutpost.access.guest.desc: May enter the outer yard. Citadel and chests are closed.
lordsoutpost.access.hostile.desc: Guards attack on entering the perimeter. No interaction allowed.
lordsoutpost.order.posts.tip: Stand at posts: archers on walls and towers, others at the gate.
lordsoutpost.order.patrol.tip: Walk a loop through waypoints. Set them on the map; without them the default round is used.
lordsoutpost.order.retinue.tip: Escort the Lord on journeys. The fallen are carried to the infirmary.
lordsoutpost.title.conquered.sub: Place the Lord's Standard in the yard
lordsoutpost.chat.founded: %s raises the Standard: this is now a Lord's domain (%s).
lordsoutpost.standard.already_lord: You already own an outpost. One Lord, one domain.
lordsoutpost.standard.outside: The Standard must be placed in the yard of a conquered outpost.
lordsoutpost.msg.abandoned: You abandoned the outpost. The residents have left.
lordsoutpost.msg.standard_sneak: Break the Standard while sneaking to abandon the outpost.
lordsoutpost.msg.protected: This land is under the Lord's protection.
lordsoutpost.msg.locked: The garrison charter does not let you open this.
lordsoutpost.msg.not_lord: You do not own an outpost.
lordsoutpost.msg.no_access: %s is Lord %s's domain. Management is for allies.
lordsoutpost.msg.law_cooldown: The law can be changed once per in-game day.
lordsoutpost.msg.unknown_player: No player with that name was found.
lordsoutpost.msg.deliver_far: Resources can only be delivered inside the outpost.
lordsoutpost.msg.nothing_to_deliver: No matching items in your inventory.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact_incoming: The Lord of %s offers a %s. Answer in the Diplomacy tab.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact.offered: Offer sent. Waiting for the other Lord's answer.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact.too_far: That outpost is too far for a pact.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact.no_gold: Not enough gold in the treasury.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact.need_trade_first: A trade pact is needed first.
lordsoutpost.msg.pact.invalid: No pact is possible with that outpost.
lordsoutpost.msg.caravan.no_pact: A caravan needs a trade pact.
lordsoutpost.msg.caravan.no_leader: No free Caravaneer (they arrive from tier 2).
lordsoutpost.msg.caravan.no_cargo: Nothing to carry: no surplus in stock.
lordsoutpost.event.conquered: The Captain fell and the garrison scattered.
lordsoutpost.event.reclaimed: Marauders returned to the abandoned fort.
lordsoutpost.event.starving: Famine: the larders are empty and work goes at half pace.
lordsoutpost.event.raid_lost: The raid was not repelled: stores plundered. Wounded: %s, dead: %s.
lordsoutpost.event.wounded: %s is wounded and sent to the infirmary.
lordsoutpost.event.mage_work: The Court Mage finished a work: see the Tribute Chest.
lordsoutpost.event.caravan_lost: A caravan was lost on the road.
lordsoutpost.event.ambush_won: The escort fought off an ambush.
lordsoutpost.event.ambush_lost: Ambush: the caravan lost half its cargo.
lordsoutpost.map.title: Outpost Map
lordsoutpost.map.overworld_only: Outposts exist only in the Overworld.
lordsoutpost.map.help: Drag to pan · Wheel to zoom · Space: to player · Home: to your fort · Click a marker for details
lordsoutpost.map.help_route: LMB: add waypoint · RMB: remove last · Done: send the patrol around the loop
lordsoutpost.map.help_hold: Click the spot the squad should hold
lordsoutpost.map.pact_trade.tip: Enables caravans and raises tribute. With marauders it costs treasury gold; with a Lord it needs consent.
lordsoutpost.map.pact_military.tip: The neighbor stops raiding and helps in defense. Requires a trade pact.
lordsoutpost.map.caravan.tip: A caravaneer with escort carries the surplus. Caravans are faster on roads.
lordsoutpost.map.route.tip: Draw a patrol loop on the map.
lordsoutpost.map.hold.tip: Pick a spot for the squad to hold. Press again to cancel.
lordsoutpost.ui.title: Outpost
lordsoutpost.ui.name: Fort name
lordsoutpost.ui.naming: What shall your domain be called?
lordsoutpost.ui.naming.hint: Up to 32 characters. You can rename it later.
lordsoutpost.ui.boosted: Boost from the Lord's help: %s min left
lordsoutpost.ui.abandon.tip: You stop being the Lord, residents leave, buildings stay. Click twice.
lordsoutpost.ui.fighter.tip:
%s, %s
Health %s%% · armor %s%% (%s) · kills: %s
Click to move to the next squad
lordsoutpost.ui.garrison.hint: Click a fighter to move them to another squad. Routes and positions are set on the map.
lordsoutpost.ui.access.empty: The list is empty: everyone gets the default level.
lordsoutpost.ui.access.default.tip: Access level for players who are not on the list.
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.auto_ally: Ally the Lords of allied forts
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.auto_ally.tip: Lords of forts you have a pact with count as allies automatically.
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.allies_tribute: Allies may open the Tribute Chest
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.allies_tribute.ti: When off, only the Lord opens the Tribute Chest.
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.protect.tip: Guests and hostiles cannot break or place blocks and explosions do no damage. Allies never break blocks either way.
lordsoutpost.ui.toggle.auto_caravans.tip: The Steward dispatches surplus caravans to trade partners on his own.
lordsoutpost.ui.quests.title: Quest board: what the settlement is short of
lordsoutpost.ui.quests.empty: No shortages. The settlement is coping on its own.
lordsoutpost.ui.quests.deliver.tip: Hand over matching items from your inventory (stand inside the fort).
lordsoutpost.ui.quests.hint: Without your help the residents make up the shortage themselves, only slower. A completed quest doubles the speed of the related work. You can also put items into the supply barrel at the storehouse.
lordsoutpost.ui.diplomacy.title: Neighboring outposts
lordsoutpost.ui.diplomacy.empty: You have not scouted any neighbors yet. Find them on the map (M).
lordsoutpost.ui.diplomacy.caravan.tip: Send a caravan with the surplus. Trips done: %s. Share of the way on roads: %s%%.
lordsoutpost.cmd.none_here: There is no outpost here and you do not own one.
lordsoutpost.cmd.not_wild: This outpost is no longer held by marauders.
lordsoutpost.cmd.raid: A raid will start within seconds.
lordsoutpost.cmd.removed: Outpost removed from the world (buildings remain).
